Name: Nyapu-Style WAG
Author: nugmods
Description:
Nyapu-Style portraits for the artisan goods expansion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods![/url] I drew... so many things from scratch, haha.You can also now get matching portraits for the Sunberry Village addon Rose and the Alchemist over at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33905]Nyapu-Style Sunberry Village[/url] hub!

These portraits were made with a combination of Nyapu's original pixel art and (a large amount) of my own edits made from scratch. A handful of outfit items (hats, scarves) also use AirynS's original art. All credit goes to Nyapu for their original work, as always, with many thanks for their generous permissions.

[b]Install Instructions:[/b]

1. Drag and drop the [CP] file into your mod folder. That's it!

[b]Credits:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]Nyapu[/url] - for their pixel art, used to make these portraits, and all their hard work for the community
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods/mods]Wildflour[/url] - for Wildflour's Atelier Goods, and kindly allowing me to share these!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]AirynS[/url] - Florian's hat, Rose's hat, and Wisteria's scarf!
